senses.gloss: f. (v. סַרְדּוּתָא) [net-work,] coarse web or matting, esp. stuffed matting used for stoppers of stoves, bag.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 8:3">Kel. VIII, 3</cite> (some ed. <he>סדורה</he>); <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 9:7">ib. IX, 7</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 10:7">Ib. X, 7</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>סְרֵידוֹת</he>. Tanḥ.

<cite ref="Exodus 18">B’shall. 18</cite> <he>הבא … וימלאו ס׳ תבן</he> (some ed. <he>סדירות</he>) get ten strong men and let them stuff bags with straw; ed. Bub. 17 <cite ref="O01552"><he>סְרוּדוֹת</he></cite>; v. <cite ref="A00445"><he>אֵדֶר</he> I</cite>.
